title: A Fentanyl Vaccine Is About to Get Its First Major Test
summary: ARMR Sciences of New York is trialing a vaccine in the Netherlands to protect against fentanyl-related overdose and death.

title: RBC Beats Estimates on Capital Markets, Wealth Management
summary: Royal Bank of Canada topped estimates on strong results in its capital-markets and wealth-management divisions, capping off a year that saw elevated trading activity and a return to dealmaking in the US.

title: Germany Faces a Growing Power Gap as Delays Hit New Gas Projects
summary: Germany is heading toward a potential power shortfall of 10 to 24 gigawatts in 2030 during high-demand periods as it closes generation faster than it builds replacements — a gap analysts say has to be bridged.
